column5: A take the AGREEMENT stage makes while a TMDB answer its guards read is a gap: the synopsis guard compares no description it does not know and never waits on one (AgreementStage: "A description not known is nothing to compare, never waited on"); GapHold holds model decisions only. Follow-up: an agreement take made on an unknown description waits a bounded time, as GapHold does
